messages:
Maya (PM): quick mock: compact pool row that shows min/max, burst pill, and a tiny SLO knob. goal is single-line decisions without expanding cards. Liam (Designer): neat. suggestion: show a small relative latency delta next to burst (e.g., ~+20ms est.) so users get tradeoff context. keep it subtle so it doesn't clutter. Anne (Frontend): +1 but we need keyboard access for details. hover-only info isn't accessible. also the burst pill color fails contrast in dark theme, will need contrast tweak. Samir (SRE): latency delta should be relative to selected model routing. recommend wording: "~+Xms (est.)" and a tooltip "Based on recent traces for selected model". Dedicated customers can get exact numbers behind a flag. Maya (PM): copy choices: "Burst available" vs "Burst headroom". Which is clearer on a compact row? Liam (Designer): "Burst available" feels more like a resource stat. keep the label short and add aria-label for screen readers like "Burst available, estimated latency and cost". Anne (Frontend): accessibility note: announcements for warnings must use role=alert and the CTA needs clear focus. snippet I plan to use: ```
No burst available 94 requests may queue
``` Also ensure Enter/Space expands detail when focused. Samir (SRE): when burst == 0 show inline warning: "No burst available 94 requests may queue" with action "Pick pool with burst". For Dedicated, show exact headroom numbers (flag INF-5230). ops-bot: created INF-5230 (burst-exact-flag) assigned to @Samir. Liam (Designer): layout nit: min/max steppers crowd the SLO knob at narrow widths. proposal: collapse steppers to inline micro-controls under 420px or show them on focus only. Maya (PM): SLO slider: research favored presets. propose chips low/med/high that snap but allow free adjustment. default to medium. show numeric SLO in tooltip and aria-valuetext. Anne (Frontend): implementation notes: animate slider but respect prefers-reduced-motion. update aria-live with numeric changes so AT announces the new value. make presets keyboard-navigable. Maya (PM): can Samir/Anne estimate effort by EOD? I'll attach mock and link the flag ticket. Samir (SRE): will add estimate to INF-5230 by 5pm. Anne (Frontend): will add frontend tasks and prototype notes. Maya (PM): thanks all, will iterate mocks with: relative latency delta, contrast fixes, collapsed steppers, new warning copy, presets visible on focus :thumbsup:
